meta.parties: Ranasinghe Et Al v. Dhammananda Et Al

rules.statement: An incumbent of a vihare, prior to the passing of Ordinance No. 8 of 1905 and even since its passing if no trustees have actually been appointed, is in the position of a de facto trustee who can acquire property for the temple by prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: The incumbent of the vihare, prior to the passing of Ordinance No. 8 of 1905 and even since its passing if no trustees have actually been appointed, is therefore in the position of a de facto trustee, and as such he can acquire for the temple by prescription in spite of section 41 of the Ordinance (now repealed) which, while in force, enacted a species of prohibition in mortmain on the acquisition of new properties for a vihare.
